newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese economy develops favourably in Q3 - INE.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese economy develops favourably in Q3 - INE.

text.p: The Portuguese economy grew more favourably in the third quarter of 1996 than the second, helped by a recovery in the construction and manufacturing industries, the National Statistics Institute (INE) said.
"The economy grew more favourably in the third quarter of 1996, taking into consideration leading indicators," INE said in its report for September.
The leading indicator of economic activity grew 0.9 percent in September, compared with a 0.7 percent fall in August.

"Production in manufacturing and construction continues to recover, contributing to the development of economic activity," INE said. "This recovery was moderate in industry, but quite significant in construction."
